name: universal-official-skills
description: Read-only software guidance within explicitly authorized codebases, with official sources, reuse proposals, no code/data overwrites, and no external codebase-data sharing.

defaultPrompt: Inspect only my authorized codebase. Use official guidance; suggest fixes without changing code or sharing codebase data.
interface.longDescription: Inspect only explicitly authorized codebases and propose reuse or fixes without applying them. Never modify or overwrite project code or data, even after proposal approval. Never send codebase content or derived private data to external tools, services, search engines, remote agents, uploads, or storage. Consult official vendor skills and documentation using generic product/API/version queries. Report inspected scope, evidence, proposed diffs, and unperformed checks. This independent skills-only plugin provides instructions, not runtime permissions, an execution sandbox, or network enforcement. The host processes supplied content under its own policies; strictly local processing requires a verified local/offline host. Includes pinned official catalogs for ServiceNow, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Anthropic.
capabilities: No project writes or data exports

publication.release_notes: Restricts the default workflow to explicitly authorized read-only code inspection. Prohibits project writes and external transmission of inspected data; documents host processing limits.
